qnl_arabic_ocr_v2.name: Qatar National Library Arabic OCR Corpus v2 (2,894 cataloged works)
qnl_arabic_ocr_v2.content_type: OCR text of out-of-copyright printed works; catalog metadata
qnl_arabic_ocr_v2.commercial_use: permitted for the declared out-of-copyright text; metadata CC0; preserve source attribution in project records
qnl_arabic_ocr_v2.derivatives: permitted for public-domain texts; CC0 metadata
qnl_arabic_ocr_v2.redistribution: not planned; confirm each applicable repository term before any external redistribution
qnl_arabic_ocr_v2.training_use: approved for local model-training corpus ingestion based on item license metadata and depositor statement that texts are out-of-copyright
qnl_arabic_ocr_v2.verification_method: Official Manara Figshare public API metadata and QNL Manara terms reviewed; item API states CC0 dataset license and specifically states texts are out-of-copyright works; v2 files and supplied MD5 recorded before use.
qnl_arabic_ocr_v2.legal_review_note: QNL Manara terms state item-specific licenses govern. No redistribution of the downloaded package is planned. OCR quality and source record metadata are checked locally. Not individualized legal advice.
qnl_arabic_ocr_v2.allowed_use: local corpus processing and training from the declared public-domain text; metadata under CC0
qnl_arabic_ocr_v2.notes: Use only version 2 files identified in API metadata. Each text file has original QNL record number and repository ID; retain document grouping. Do not treat this OCR corpus as modern general-domain Arabic.
